fullText.simplified:
第13章、一群帮手，一起改变

    通过包公的努力，王家兄弟杀史元的案子终于有了进展。
    那天，史元喝多了酒，王家三兄弟刚好找到他，想要抓他去官府。史元很不高兴，马上拿出了刀对着王大，就差一点儿，死的就是王大了。两个弟弟为了哥哥追上前去，却又怕史元杀人，不敢动他。王二就只能一只手挡着哥哥的脖子，一只手把王大朝后面推。王二手上的伤就是这时候来的。
    王三从后面拉住史元，想要分开史元和王大，没想到史元反过手来，就想给王三一刀。王三手上的伤就是这样来的。
    但史元喝多了酒，站不直，他动作太大，不小心扑到了地上，那把刀就这样插进了自己的肚子。
    包公终于知道了事情的经过，果然，王家三兄弟都是好人，在危险到来的时候，没有人离开，也没有人杀人。王三如果就这样死去，那真是太不公平了。但史元死了，他是公主的侄子，皇帝的亲戚，包公总得把事情告诉皇帝。
    包公做好被免去工作的准备，把真正的情况告诉了皇帝。他本以为皇帝会怪他抓了自己的亲戚，但没想到，皇帝听完以后，也很不喜欢史家这样做。
    皇帝摇摇头，冷笑说：“这件事真是太让人生气了！我是皇帝，还要常常提醒自己关心人民，想不到这些史家人这么威风，比我还威风呢！”
    包公也叹气道：“是的，史家人完全是在用公主和您的名字害人。尤其是史元，他做的坏事，我一一写下来了，写了整整三张纸，请您看看。”
    皇帝把那些文件仔仔细细地看了一遍，气得扔掉了桌上的书和杯子：“太不像话了！公主呢？公主知道这些事吗？”
    包公回答说：“公主也不知道，她向您道歉，请您一定要公正地办这个案子。”
    皇帝明白了，他想了想说：“人们都说“千里之堤溃于蚁穴”，意思是说有人修了一千里的路，却因为蚂蚁进去而坏掉。史家就像蚂蚁，只要有这样的坏人在，就会让我们国家也慢慢变坏。来人，把王家三兄弟放了，把史家人抓起来，仔细算一算他们做的坏事，然后告诉所有人！”
    就这样，皇帝不仅不怪王家三兄弟，还奖了他们很多东西。后来，王家三兄弟坚持读书学习，王大当上了官，王二开了一家书店，王三也当了老师。而王母呢，皇帝送给她一个很好的名号——“好心的妻子”。他们一家人心很好，一点也不自私，大家都相信他们，喜欢他们。
fullText.traditional:
第13章、一群幫手，一起改變

    通過包公的努力，王家兄弟殺史元的案子終於有了進展。
    那天，史元喝多了酒，王家三兄弟剛好找到他，想要抓他去官府。史元很不高興，馬上拿出了刀對著王大，就差一點兒，死的就是王大了。兩個弟弟為了哥哥追上前去，卻又怕史元殺人，不敢動他。王二就只能一隻手擋著哥哥的脖子，一隻手把王大朝後面推。王二手上的傷就是這時候來的。
    王三從後面拉住史元，想要分開史元和王大，沒想到史元反過手來，就想給王三一刀。王三手上的傷就是這樣來的。
    但史元喝多了酒，站不直，他動作太大，不小心撲到了地上，那把刀就這樣插進了自己的肚子。
    包公終於知道了事情的經過，果然，王家三兄弟都是好人，在危險到來的時候，沒有人離開，也沒有人殺人。王三如果就這樣死去，那真是太不公平了。但史元死了，他是公主的姪子，皇帝的親戚，包公總得把事情告訴皇帝。
    包公做好被免去工作的準備，把真正的情況告訴了皇帝。他本以為皇帝會怪他抓了自己的親戚，但沒想到，皇帝聽完以後，也很不喜歡史家這樣做。
    皇帝搖搖頭，冷笑說：“這件事真是太讓人生氣了！我是皇帝，還要常常提醒自己關心人民，想不到這些史家人這麼威風，比我還威風呢！”
    包公也嘆氣道：“是的，史家人完全是在用公主和您的名字害人。尤其是史元，他做的壞事，我一一寫下來了，寫了整整三張紙，請您看看。”
    皇帝把那些文件仔仔細細地看了一遍，氣得扔掉了桌上的書和杯子：“太不像話了！公主呢？公主知道這些事嗎？”
    包公回答說：“公主也不知道，她向您道歉，請您一定要公正地辦這個案子。”
    皇帝明白了，他想了想說：“人們都說“千里之堤潰於蟻穴”，意思是說有人修了一千里的路，卻因為螞蟻進去而壞掉。史家就像螞蟻，只要有這樣的壞人在，就會讓我們國家也慢慢變壞。來人，把王家三兄弟放了，把史家人抓起來，仔細算一算他們做的壞事，然後告訴所有人！”
    就這樣，皇帝不僅不怪王家三兄弟，還獎了他們很多東西。後來，王家三兄弟堅持讀書學習，王大當上了官，王二開了一家書店，王三也當了老師。而王母呢，皇帝送給她一個很好的名號——“好心的妻子”。他們一家人心很好，一點也不自私，大家都相信他們，喜歡他們。

sentences.pinyin: hòu lái wáng jiā sān xiōng dì jiān chí dú shū xué xí
sentences.english: Later, the three Wang brothers persevered with studying and learning.

sentences.simplified: 王大当上了官，王二开了一家书店，王三也当了老师。
sentences.traditional: 王大當上了官，王二開了一家書店，王三也當了老師。
sentences.pinyin: wáng dà dāng shàng le guān wáng èr kāi le yì jiā shū diàn wáng sān yě dāng le lǎo shī
sentences.english: Wang Da became an official, Wang Er opened a bookstore, and Wang San became a teacher.

sentences.simplified: 而王母呢，皇帝送给她一个很好的名号——“好心的妻子”。
sentences.traditional: 而王母呢，皇帝送給她一個很好的名號——“好心的妻子”。
sentences.pinyin: ér wáng mǔ ne huáng dì sòng gěi tā yí ge hěn hǎo de míng hào hǎo xīn de qī zi
sentences.english: As for Mother Wang, the emperor gave her a very good title—“The Goodhearted Wife”.

sentences.simplified: 他们一家人心很好，一点也不自私，大家都相信他们，喜欢他们。
sentences.traditional: 他們一家人心很好，一點也不自私，大家都相信他們，喜歡他們。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì jiā rén xīn hěn hǎo yì diǎn yě bú zì sī dà jiā dōu xiāng xìn tā men xǐ huan tā men
sentences.english: The family members had good hearts and were not selfish at all. Everyone trusted them and liked them.

sentence_translations: Chapter 13: A Group of Helpers Making Changes Together
Through Lord Bao’s efforts, the case of the Wang brothers killing Shi Yuan finally made progress.
That day, Shi Yuan had drunk too much wine. The three Wang brothers happened to find him and wanted to take him to the authorities.
Shi Yuan was very upset and immediately pulled a sword against Wang Da. It was almost Wang Da who died.
The two younger brothers chased after their older brother but were afraid to move him for fear that Shi Yuan would kill him.
Wang Er could only block his brother’s neck with one hand and push Wang Da back with the other.
That was when Wang Er’s hand was injured.
Wang San pulled Shi Yuan from behind and tried to separate Shi Yuan and Wang Da, ..
.. but unexpectedly, Shi Yuan turned around and tried to give him a cut instead.
That was how Wang San’s hand was injured.
But Shi Yuan had drunk too much wine and could not even stand up straight.
He overshot his target and accidentally threw himself to the ground, plunging the sword into his own stomach.
Lord Bao finally found out what had happened, and sure enough, the three Wang brothers were good people.
When they encountered danger, no one ran away, and no one killed anyone.
It would be so unfair for Wang San to die because of this.
But Shi Yuan was dead. He was the nephew of the princess, a relative of the emperor. Lord Bao had to tell the emperor what had happened.
Lord Bao prepared himself to be removed from his position and told the emperor what really happened.
He thought the emperor would blame him for arresting his relatives, but to his surprise, ..
.. after hearing about this, the emperor also disliked what the Shi family had done.
The emperor shook his head and laughed grimly:
“This matter is so infuriating! I am the emperor and constantly remind myself to take good care of the people.
I can’t imagine that these Shi family members had so much authority, even more authority than me!”
Lord Bao also sighed and said, “Yes, the Shi family was totally using the princess’s and your good name to harm the people.
Especially Shi Yuan. I wrote down every single bad thing he did. It took three whole pages. Please take a look.”
The emperor read the documents carefully and got so angry that he threw the books and cups on the table:
“This is so improper! And the princess? Did the princess know about these things?”
Lord Bao replied, “The princess didn’t know either. She apologizes to you and asks you to be sure to handle the case fairly.”
The emperor understood. He thought about it and said: “Just like a thousand-li dyke can collapse because of an ant colony,” ..
.. meaning that people can build a thousand-li road, but it can be destroyed because ants get into it.
The Shi family are like ants, and as long as there are such bad people around, they will slowly make our country bad as well.
Men, release the three Wang brothers!
Arrest the Shi family, carefully account for the bad things they did, and then tell everyone!”
In this way, as well as not blaming the three Wang brothers, the emperor also awarded them many things.
Later, the three Wang brothers persevered with studying and learning.
Wang Da became an official, Wang Er opened a bookstore, and Wang San became a teacher.
As for Mother Wang, the emperor gave her a very good title—“The Goodhearted Wife”.
The family members had good hearts and were not selfish at all. Everyone trusted them and liked them.
